en.body:
Hold onto your hard hats, scare floor employees! The much-anticipated Monstropolis, a land dedicated to the wonderfully wacky world of **Monsters, Inc.**, is officially slated to open at **Disney's Hollywood Studios** in 2027. Announced at the recent D23 event, this marks a significant expansion for **Disney World**, promising to immerse guests in the city powered by screams and, more recently, laughter.

Construction on this vibrant new area began in 2025, transforming a section of Grand Avenue into the bustling streets of Monstropolis. Guests will have the unique opportunity to stroll alongside beloved characters like **Mike Wazowski** and **Sulley**, experiencing a story that continues after the events of the original film. The narrative focus will highlight how the monsters now harness the power of laughter to energize their city, offering a heartwarming continuation of the iconic narrative. A major highlight will be **Disney Parks' first-ever suspended coaster**, designed to simulate a thrilling journey through the door vault and the bustling monster factory. Beyond the adrenaline-pumping ride, Monstropolis will also feature new retail locations offering exclusive merchandise and themed dining experiences, including a spot called **Archie's Scare Pig Pizza**.

> "We’re so excited to bring Monstropolis to life for fans." — Michael Hundgen, Vice President Creative, Walt Disney World Portfolio at Walt Disney Imagineering

The announcement has sent waves of excitement through the global fanbase. For many, **Monsters, Inc.** represents a formative childhood experience, blending genuine scares with heartwarming lessons about friendship and courage. The prospect of stepping directly into this world, interacting with characters, and experiencing the unique energy of Monstropolis is a dream come true for cinephiles and theme park enthusiasts alike. This land isn't just about rides; it's about recapturing the magic of a story that resonated deeply, offering a tangible connection to a universe many have grown up with. The promise of a new theater show and the chance to explore a living, breathing city populated by monsters ensures that this will be more than just a themed area – it will be an adventure.

## A New Chapter for Scare-Based Entertainment

Monstropolis is poised to become a cornerstone attraction at **Disney's Hollywood Studios**, offering a fresh narrative that builds upon the beloved **Monsters, Inc.** legacy. Imagineers have focused on creating an environment that is both visually stunning and narratively rich, ensuring that the spirit of Pixar's innovation shines through. The integration of a suspended coaster with a vertical lift that plunges riders through the iconic door vault promises a unique thrill that sets it apart from existing attractions. This new land signifies Disney's continued commitment to bringing animated classics to life in immersive and unforgettable ways, further solidifying its position as a leader in theme park entertainment.

## What Happens After the Screams?

With construction well underway since 2025, the 2027 opening date is eagerly anticipated. Fans can expect further details regarding specific showtimes, character meet-and-greets, and dining reservations to be released closer to the grand opening. The addition of Monstropolis is part of a larger wave of new experiences coming to **Disney World**, promising even more magic for visitors in the years to come. Keep your eyes peeled for updates as this exciting new world takes shape.
